chunks: Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abi Ubaydah, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, that he said:
"Whoever drinks wine, then flog him; if he returns, then flog him; if he returns, then kill him."

key_terms.عَادَ: returned to the act; repeated the offense

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for repeatedly drinking wine in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal punishment for drinking wine and indicates escalating penalties for repeated offense. It belongs to the chapter on the hadd concerning intoxication and consumption of intoxicants, reflecting the gravity of khamr in Islamic jurisprudence.
